patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient has been increasingly disruptive in class according to his teacher. objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with behavior issues at school and at home.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Hi. Lately at school I’ve been getting in trouble for not doing what the teacher asks—sometimes I argue like ‘you can’t make me.’ I don’t really like gym class, but I’m fine and even play a lot during recess, and I get along well with my classmates.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any areas of your skin that look scratched, rubbed raw, or have small open spots (excoriations)?
turns.patient_answer: “Not that I can think of—my skin doesn’t usually look scratched or rubbed raw, and I don’t have any open spots.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any episodes where you stop breathing or have pauses in breathing during sleep (for example, someone tells you, or you wake up gasping)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t think I’ve ever stopped breathing or had pauses in my sleep, and I don’t usually wake up gasping.”

turns.doctor_question: After your minor injury or fall, have you noticed any signs that a bone might be broken—such as severe pain, swelling, bruising, deformity, or trouble using the injured area? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No. I didn’t have a fall or any injury like that, and I haven’t noticed severe pain, swelling, bruising, deformity, or trouble using any body part.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any redness or warmth on your **left wrist** (the skin looking red compared to the other side)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any redness or warmth on my left wrist, and it doesn’t look different from the other side.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bruising on your chest wall (for example, from a bump, fall, coughing, or injury), or any new discoloration there?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have any bruising or new discoloration on my chest wall. I haven’t had any bump, fall, or injury there, and coughing hard hasn’t caused any marks either.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been urinating much more than usual lately—like needing to go to the bathroom more often or producing a larger amount of urine?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t been going to the bathroom more often or making bigger amounts of urine than usual.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you used any substances such as alcohol, tobacco, cannabis, opioids (including prescription pain pills), stimulants, or other drugs in the past or currently?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t used any substances like alcohol, tobacco, cannabis, prescription pain pills, or other drugs.” “I don’t take any medications either, and I’m not using anything at school or at home.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any trouble controlling your urine—such as leaking urine or not making it to the bathroom in time?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had trouble controlling my urine—no leaking and I can make it to the bathroom in time. I don’t feel like I’m wetting myself or having accidents.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any new or changing skin spot, sore, or growth anywhere on your body? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any new or changing skin spots, sores, or growths anywhere on my body.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any nosebleeds recently (even a small amount), or blood coming from your nose?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any nosebleeds or blood coming from my nose.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any rash on your trunk (chest, back, or belly)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any rash on my trunk—nothing on my chest, back, or belly that looks different or itchy.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any swollen, twisted, or bulging veins in your legs (varicose veins), especially around the calves or ankles?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any bulging or twisted veins in my legs, and I don’t have any swelling around my calves or ankles.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you ever been diagnosed with eczema, or have you had recurring itchy, dry, or inflamed skin patches? (Yes or No)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I’ve never been diagnosed with eczema, and I don’t get itchy, dry, or inflamed skin patches that keep coming back.”
